blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: breakpoint — A chosen instruction where execution pauses.
Step Into — Enter a called function for debugging.
Step Over — Execute a call without entering it line by line.
watch — IDE display of chosen variables/expressions.
object state — Current values of an object's fields and properties.

blocks.title: Set a breakpoint
blocks.text: Pause at a method call or the following instruction to inspect current state.

blocks.title: Step into to inspect internals
blocks.text: Step Into executes the called method one instruction at a time. Watch Count and parameter n.

blocks.title: Step over to skip internals
blocks.text: Step Over runs the entire call and pauses at the next statement, allowing you to inspect the result.
